description:
Pamela Nel of Patrick Leonard Wilson & Keenan Estates are proud to present Ballyhooly Lodge/ Castle Tavern to the market—a truly exceptional landmark property offering history, character and outstanding potential in one of North Cork's most picturesque settings.

Set in the heart of Ballyhooly village, just 10 minutes from Fermoy and 20 minutes from Mallow, this remarkable residence overlooks the River Blackwater with breathtaking views towards the iconic Ballyhooly Castle. Nestled in the foothills of the Nagle Mountains and surrounded by the beauty of the Blackwater Valley, this is a rare opportunity to acquire a property that combines lifestyle, heritage and exciting future possibilities.

Originally known as the Castle Tavern, Ballyhooly Lodge has been lovingly cared for by its current owners , evolving into a substantial family home while retaining its unique period charm. One of the property's standout features is the former dance hall, now beautifully converted into a peaceful yoga studio, offering a versatile space for wellness, creative pursuits or alternative uses.

The property offers 9 bedrooms with potential for a 10th bedroom and 6,5 bathrooms, included in this is a substantial self-contained five-bedroom guest accommodation wing, creating excellent flexibility for extended family living or guest accommodation. Subject to the necessary planning permission, buyers may wish to explore opportunities for further residential use or reconfiguration.

Beyond the property itself, Ballyhooly is renowned for its rich heritage and unspoilt natural surroundings. Castleblagh Woods sits on the doorstep, providing scenic woodland walks and riverside trails, while the surrounding area is home to many of Cork's most fascinating historical sites, including Labacallee Wedge Tomb, Bridgetown Priory, Glenville Mass Rock, Doonpeter Holy Well and Famine Walk, and the Nano Nagle Birthplace.

For buyers seeking to restore and enhance a historic property, Ballyhooly Lodge may be eligible for a range of government-supported schemes, subject to eligibility and approval. 

Purchasers are advised to make their own enquiries regarding available supports and planning requirements.

Whether you are searching for a distinctive family residence, a boutique guest accommodation opportunity, a wellness retreat, or a unique lifestyle investment, Ballyhooly Lodge offers an exceptional opportunity to create something truly special in an unforgettable setting.

Features

Landmark period property with exceptional character and history

Approximately 9 bedrooms with potential for a 10th bedroom and 6,5 bathrooms .

Which includes a Self-contained five-bedroom guest accommodation wing

Stunning views overlooking Ballyhooly Castle and the River Blackwater

Prime village location just 10 minutes from Fermoy and 20 minutes from Mallow

Castleblagh Woods and scenic woodland walks on the doorstep

Ideal for multi-generational living, guest accommodation or a wellness venture (subject to planning permission)

Potential for further development or reconfiguration (subject to planning permission)

Separate workshop

BER D1 efficient rating 

Ample on-site parking

Close to renowned heritage attractions throughout the Blackwater Valley

Potential eligibility for renovation, conservation and heritage grant schemes (subject to qualifying criteria)
